title: Exo-Gargantua: a calibrated resolver for orbital-period aliases in TESS transit signals

creators.name: Banerjee, Srijeet Prasad
creators.affiliation: Guru Nanak Institute of Technology, Kolkata, India

description: Calibrated period-alias resolver for TESS transit and eclipse signals, with the injection-recovery (B1), temporal-holdout (B2), eclipsing-binary (B5), false-alarm and runtime (B4) benchmarks, the scripts that generate every number, table and figure of the accompanying AJ manuscript, and the released per-target tables.
